CustomObject.description: THE CREATE-LEG RECORD, twenty-first stamp item 6, shipped with the resolution-stage rebuild per the twenty-seventh. One row per org record the machine created - a Contact minted from a roster participant or a resolved mention - because A MACHINE-CREATED ROW WE CANNOT ENUMERATE IS A ROW WE CAN NEVER DISOWN. This is the watermark law reaching creation: the enumeration that makes "which rows did we put in this org, and which do we now disown" a query rather than archaeology. Machine-created org data is marked and reported through this record, never deleted by us: deleting a row someone may have since touched is the destructive move this build has refused repeatedly, so mark-and-report is the honest disposition. First row: Dan Lewis, created 8 August 2026 through the roster-participant leg ahead of this record, back-filled by the ruling that shipped it.
